yamlCheck.explanation: The four-day organizing advance and three flight dawns account for seven boundaries conditional on the June 14 opening, through June 21. The June 19 evening conversations are retrospective within that flight, not extra days. The six additional days around Apporia at u2030–u2060 are an accepted itinerary, but completion is deferred to a future introduction at u2072–u2075.
